description: This PHP source file defines a final class PregReplaceCallbackClosureTypeExtension that implements a specific interface for extending PHPStan's static method type inference related to regex replacement methods. It primarily provides logic to determine the types of callback parameters used in preg_replace_callback methods, involving regex pattern matching and type simplification.

classes.name: PregReplaceCallbackClosureTypeExtension
classes.description: Implements PHPStan extension for determining the type signature of callback functions used in preg_replace_callback methods, supporting static method reflection and regex pattern analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex shape matcher used to interpret regex patterns.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if the given method and parameter are supported by this extension, primarily preg_replace_callback or preg_replace_callback_strict_groups methods with a 'replacement' parameter.

methods.name: getTypeFromStaticMethodCall
methods.description: Determines the resulting PHPStan type for the callback parameter for specific preg_replace_callback method calls, analyzing regex patterns and providing a closure type accordingly.
